script_text:
Stop! Aries, the stars are truly screaming at you right now.

Mars, your ruling planet, is truly locked in a square to Neptune in your 7th House, clouding judgments in partnerships and sowing confusion in love matters. Meanwhile, Venus forms a powerful trine to your 10th House, fueling ambition and opening professional doors.

Love now feels like a tempest—the Neptune square stirs doubt, urging you to trust instinct and avoid romantic spirals; single Aries will attract bold, adventurous spirits drawn to your bright fiery confidence daily.

Career wise, Venus's trine to your 10th House unleashes a surge of confidence, granting leadership opportunities and a surprise bonus by midday; a strategic negotiation could seal a lucrative contract.

Beware of impulsive promises under Neptune's haze—hold back before signing anything crucial.

Follow for tomorrow's fiery reading and stay ahead of the cosmic flow.
